name: veronica-and-sam-wedding
description: Wedding website for Veronica and Samuel — Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.sync-guests: wrangler kv key put --binding=GUESTS --preview false list --path=functions/guests.json
scripts.sync-guests:local: wrangler kv key put --binding=GUESTS --preview false --local list --path=functions/guests.json
scripts.deploy: npm run sync-guests && wrangler pages deploy ./deploy/public
